contexts.text: No happiness of life without active life. HH 403. Explained.
Praising the Lord is not such active life, but is an effect of that life.

In the simplest organic [forms] of man there is a passive and an active, and unless these were coupled as it were in a marriage like that of man and wife, they could not be there, still less produce anything. In like manner in universal nature.
Diverse activities of forces and motions in the body.
Man's inward [substances] are in a certain unknown activity... the activity of this sphere extends itself...

The activity (of that celestial state) is thus described. Worship itself is nothing but a certain activity existing from the celestial within; the celestial itself can never be without activity; worship is the first activity... all good of love and of charity is the essential activity itself.
The rational in itself is nothing unless affection flows into it and makes it active...
Since they correspond to each other, as active and passive, it is called correspondence.

Delight from good and pleasantness from truth, which constitute blessedness in Heaven, do not consist in idleness but in activity... Delight and pleasantness endure permanently, and are continually elevated in activity, and constitute blessedness. Activity with those in Heaven consists in performing uses...
The reason why the Angels are His ministries is that they may be in active life, and thence in happiness.
Man's thought is active and passive. Explained. The mouth of man = active, or speaking thought. AC 6987:2. Explained.
Active thought is the speech of man's spirit.
In order to the production of anything, there must be two forces, one called active and the other passive...
Desire is the activity itself of life...
Power, which is the activity of life. AC 10023:end.
The activity of the whole body is brought together in the arms and hands...
Moral and civil life is the activity of spiritual life. Explained.
Forms are substances, forces are their activities...
Activities and motions.
They excite the atmospheres to their activities.
Prior things continually decrease in activity and expansion even to ultimates; when their activity and expansion cease in ultimates...
That love or the will is thus in its sensitive, and in its active life. General article. DLW 407.
Activity in man corresponds to the Divine proceeding in the Lord.
All activity proceeds from the soul through the body.
The idea that the inward activity of nature is life. TCR 351:10.
The activity of love produces the sense of delight, its activity in Heaven is with wisdom, and its activity in Hell is with insanity.
This influx of love and wisdom is the activity itself from which is all the delight that is called Good.

Both an active and a passive are necessary to every operation; it is the same with the spiritual and the natural, the spiritual, being a living force, is active, and the natural, being a dead force, is passive. TCR 607:2.
Attributes all activity to the Lord. TCR 150.
Man's activity does not proceed from the soul through the body, but out of the body from the soul.
Life is the inmost activity of the love and wisdom that are in God, and are God...
Activity itself, regarded in itself, is not creatable... Sound, which is the activity of the atmosphere, is not creatable; neither is heat, which is the primary activity...
It is from creation that where there are actives there are also passives; if the actives were creatable, like the passives, there would have been no need of a sun...
The (natural) sun consists of created substances the activity of which produces fire.
Under Act, see this reference.
The actives of life are called celestial things, and the passives, spiritual things...
That no effect can exist in the universe without an active and a passive, thus without a marriage...
Only an active life has joy in it, and it is life because it is active. See also SE 4182.

In order to appropriation there must be an active and a reactive, the active is from the Lord, and also the reactive, but this appears as if it were from man, for the Lord Himself gives this reactive.
All activities are changes of state and variations of form.
